title: Give Your Heart
description: Use the command to transfer hearts to another player.
body:
This plugin allows you to transfer hearts to a player within a radius previously configured in the config file (5 blocks by default). If the world is in Hardcore mode, upon death, the designated heir will be notified of the location of the hearts they can retrieve.

Commands:
- /heart player/target count - to transfer hearts
- /heartheir player - to set heir (hardcore)
- /gethearts player - receive the dead player's hearts (hardcore)
